overview: Evelyn on the Park sits beside West Park in Town Square. Its published collection includes apartments and duplexes; the available sample drawings cover six apartment layouts.
research.locationNote: West Park, within Town Square, Dubai.
research.priceLabel: Historical portal launch reference · confirm current terms
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s FAQ quotes AED 1,069,888 at launch; its headline rounds to AED 1.1m while marking developer stock sold out. These figures do not establish an available home.
research.paymentNote: Original calendar; elapsed instalments require an updated contract. Dates and the final handover month are indicative.
research.handoverNote: The original developer calendar targets December 2028. Property Finder instead reports February 2029. Neither is evidence of actual completion.
